# Prof. dr hab. n. med. Aleksandra Jezela-Stanek

> Personal academic website of Prof. Aleksandra Jezela-Stanek — specialist in clinical genetics (Specjalista genetyki klinicznej, MBA w ochronie zdrowia z badaniami klinicznymi). It presents verified research areas, clinical genetics expertise, selected publications and professional collaborations. Primary language: Polish.

Research interests: clinical and medical genetics, pulmogenetics (genetic basis of lung disease), rare and ultra-rare diseases, oncogenetics, pharmacogenetics, molecular diagnostics and genomic sequencing (WES, WGS, RNA analysis).

Current institution: Instytut Gruźlicy i Chorób Płuc (National Institute of Tuberculosis and Lung Diseases), Department of Genetics and Clinical Immunology, Warsaw, Poland.

## Main sections

- [O mnie / About](https://example.org/o-mnie/): biography and affiliations
- [Nauka i projekty / Research](https://example.org/nauka-i-projekty/): research areas
- [Zakres działalności / Areas of expertise](https://example.org/zakres-dzialalnosci/): clinical genetics services described in general terms
- [Publikacje / Publications](https://example.org/publikacje/): curated bibliography with DOI and PMID
- [Współpraca i kontakt / Contact](https://example.org/wspolpraca-i-kontakt/): email contact for collaboration

## Research areas

- [Pulmogenetyka (Pulmogenetics)](https://example.org/nauka-i-projekty/pulmogenetyka/): The genetic basis of lung disease, including rare disorders — from alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency to the determinants of pulmonary fibrosis.
- [Choroby rzadkie i ultrarzadkie (Rare diseases)](https://example.org/nauka-i-projekty/choroby-rzadkie/): Molecular diagnosis of rare disorders, delineating the clinical picture of novel variants, and interdisciplinary scientific collaboration.
- [Onkogenetyka (Oncogenetics)](https://example.org/nauka-i-projekty/onkogenetyka/): Genetic aspects of cancer susceptibility, diagnosis and prevention.
- [Farmakogenetyka (Pharmacogenetics)](https://example.org/nauka-i-projekty/farmakogenetyka/): The relevance of genetic variability to individualised pharmacotherapy.
- [Diagnostyka molekularna (Molecular diagnostics)](https://example.org/nauka-i-projekty/diagnostyka-molekularna/): Selecting and interpreting molecular and genomic tests in clinical practice — from gene panels to WES, WGS and RNA analysis.

- SERPINA1 and More? A Putative Genetic Contributor to Pulmonary Dysfunction in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency. Journal of Clinical Medicine, 2023. https://doi.org/10.3390/jcm12051708
